svg.title: Chapter 2, why it stands out. Most edtech platforms optimise for content volume and exam drilling. Eureka optimises for engagement and conceptual clarity, sitting at the intersection of gamified edtech and proven ALLEN coaching fundamentals. A radar chart from the report compares engagement style against content depth on five axes scored 0 to 4: Eureka scores story led 3.8, AI doubts 3.5, mock tests 3.0, live tutors 1.2 and free access 1.0. BYJU'S scores story led 2.5, AI doubts 2.0, free access 3.0, live tutors 2.2 and mock tests 2.8. Khan Academy scores story led 1.8, AI doubts 1.5, free access 4.0, live tutors 1.0 and mock tests 1.5. These are the teardown author's qualitative scores. Key insight: story led learning is Eureka's strongest differentiator; every chapter follows a consistent narrative arc, more immersive than lecture first platforms.

section.h2: Optimised for clarity, not content volume.

div.p: It sits at the intersection of gamified edtech and proven ALLEN coaching fundamentals. Key insight: story led learning is the strongest differentiator. Every chapter follows a consistent narrative arc, more immersive than lecture first platforms.
Engagement style against content depth, scored 0 to 4 per axis. Qualitative scores from the teardown, not measured data.
